requirement.title: Professional Graphics/Video settings with permanent visual-economy protection
requirement.origin: Owner standing P1C01 production directive, reconciled against live ProjectGovernor on 2026-09-29
requirement.intent: Provide a professional scalable Graphics/Video settings system whose visually strong default and opt-in higher presets preserve the DX11 1280x720 Low-Medium 30 FPS floor on the target i7 Gen6 / 8 GB RAM / ~2 GB VRAM laptop class, while recovering cost first from low-value CPU/GPU/VRAM work.
implementation_refs: CinematicBalanced remains the visually strong default direction; Performance, High, Ultra and Custom scale around it.
Display changes require preview-confirm-revert with the first pre-preview state preserved until confirm/revert.
Lower-tier texture, shadow, view-distance and foliage anchors remain unchanged until measured evidence supports revision.
Heavy assets remain soft/asynchronous, crowds pooled, and repeated decorative detail instanced/cullable.
missing_work: Land the WORLD_DETAIL_LEDGER registration on the current production branch.
Register REQ-PERF-004 and DEC-077 in ProjectGovernor.
Implement Public/Private UGameUserSettings source plus static contract tests.
Synchronize CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE and PRODUCTION_COMPLETENESS_MATRIX in the same real-code increment.
Obtain exact-head Unreal compile proof and later PIE/device/visual/performance evidence before acceptance claims.
acceptance_criteria: The target-laptop floor remains DX11 1280x720 Low-Medium 30 FPS.
CinematicBalanced is the visually strong default; High and Ultra remain opt-in.
Custom exposes resolution/window mode/VSync/frame-rate limit/render scale plus per-domain scalability controls.
Risky display changes are reversible before persistence.
Existing 600/800/1000 MB texture-pool anchors and tier-2 foliage density 0.70 remain unchanged until measured evidence supports change.
No performance improvement is claimed without exact measurement evidence.
requirement.notes: Runtime implementation remains P1C01-only and waits for ledger + Governor authority. This registration payload is not itself ProjectGovernor authority.

decision.title: P1C01 Graphics/Video uses a visually strong default with permanent visual-economy cost recovery
decision.resolution: Implement P1C01 Graphics/Video settings around Performance, CinematicBalanced, High, Ultra and Custom. Protect the low-spec 1280x720 Low-Medium 30 FPS floor and recover cost first from duplicate actors, far shadows, overdraw/translucency, redundant lights, uninstanced repetition, unnecessary Tick and invisible/far detail before sacrificing high-value composition and near-field presentation.
implementation_contract: CinematicBalanced is the visually strong default direction; Performance protects the floor; High and Ultra are opt-in; Custom exposes per-domain controls.
Preserve current low/medium/high texture pools at 600/800/1000 MB, current shadow/view-distance tiers, and foliage tier 2 at 0.70 until measured evidence justifies change.
Risky resolution/window-mode changes use preview-confirm-revert and preserve the first pre-preview snapshot across repeated preview changes.
The UI owns the visible confirmation countdown; engine settings code owns snapshot/application/confirm/rollback.
Keep P1C01 runtime scope only until Gate 6/7 permits later runtime chapters.
Heavy assets use soft references plus FStreamableManager; crowds remain pooled; repeated decorative detail prefers ISM/HISM plus LOD/culling.
Do not claim compile, PIE, device, visual or performance acceptance without exact evidence.
decision.rationale: The project needs professional user-facing scalability without trading away the visual hierarchy that makes the Shire benchmark convincing or silently raising the target-laptop baseline.
decision.evidence_boundary: GOVERNANCE REGISTRATION PAYLOAD ONLY until inserted into Data/ProjectGovernor.json after ledger registration. No runtime/device/visual/performance acceptance is implied.
